chapter: Inside the Basie rhythm section and band family
title: Who Greene hung out with; Basie on the road
summary: He roomed with Buck, Lester and Sweets, and Basie often joined them; Lester went out jamming.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Yeah. Who did you hang out with in the band?
We used to go out together.
We were close. We could be roommates and what-not.
Buck and I used to be roommates, and then Lester and I, and Sweets and I, you know, whenever the situation called.
But, we had fun. We really did.

Well, so on the road like that -- I mean, Basie -- so, he would be out on his own thing, would he? Like after the session, or something? With his lady friends, or something, or would he be with different guys, or what happened?
He used to hang out with the guys, you know.
Yeah. He used to go places with us.
Especially, you know, in that band. We used to -- as I say we were a big happy family. And, he would go, you know, some places, and sometimes he wouldn't go at all, you know.
Well, also, the guys went out and blew alot, too -- after sessions. Didn't they in those days?
Oh, yeah. Yeah. They had jam sessions. They used to go out and play. Buck and Lester and -- I don't think Herschël played too much, I don't think he went out too much.
I knew Lester went out quite a bit.
